name: pixelcreep
title: pixelcreep
blurb: upload your current pfp and a new one, pick the single pixel it starts from, crop the new one to a circle, then drag a 0-100% slider — grow a circle outward, zoom the camera in until it fills the frame dead-center, or grow the new photo's own patch in place. save any frame as a real pfp, or grab a zip of 10 frames spread across the sweep for the slow-reveal bit.
